Notice of Adverse Determination

Date of Notice: [[LETTER_DATE]]

Review Type: Adverse determination, level of care, inpatient versus observation

Determination

Cascade Mutual has completed its review of the above inpatient admission and has issued an adverse determination of level of care, inpatient versus observation. Based on the records submitted, the billed inpatient level of care is not certified. The length of stay exceeded what the documented clinical condition supported. The services are considered supportable at an observation level of care.

Basis for Determination

This review was conducted against the MCG-style criteria set applied by the plan for the admitting condition. The following guideline codes were found not met:

CHF-01: Not met. Oxygen saturation at presentation did not show hypoxemia requiring inpatient oxygen therapy.

CHF-03: Not met. Laboratory values did not show significant cardiac decompensation.

No other guideline codes were applied in reaching this determination.

Claim Adjustment Information

The claim has been adjudicated with the following codes:

CARC CO-50
RARC N130

Appeal Rights

The member, the member's authorized representative, or the treating provider acting on the member's behalf may submit a written appeal of this adverse determination of level of care, inpatient versus observation. Written appeals must be addressed to Utilization Management at the address shown on the reverse of this notice.

To support reconsideration, the appeal should reference each guideline code listed above and respond to the specific finding stated for that code. Documentation submitted should be organized by guideline code so that each argument is matched to the corresponding finding. The appeal must include a physician attestation line signed by the treating or attending physician.

Appeals must be received by [[APPEAL_DEADLINE]]. Appeals received after that date may not be eligible for review.

This determination addresses coverage of the level of care billed and does not direct or alter the care rendered by the treating provider. A copy of the specific guideline criteria used in this review is available upon written request.

Sincerely,

Medical Director, Utilization Management
Cascade Mutual
